sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: brucespringsteen.it: the script now also runs on the brucespringsteen.it record database (DB/records.aspx), off by default. Switch it on under ⚙️ Settings → 💿 BRUCESPRINGSTEEN.IT. Every format of the site's own filter is ticked. Two buttons, Unofficial and Official, each load every record of that kind, all formats, into one filterable, sortable table. Unofficial records get Title, Matrix, Format, Label, Code and Notes; official ones get Title, Catalogue, Format, Country, Promo, Code and Notes. Notes is the italic line some records carry. It works on records.aspx opened in its own tab; inside the site's two-frame view the narrow list frame is left as it is.
